topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I poured everything into it, the design, the sketches, the endless nights tweaking the mechanics until it purred like a dream. The prototype, it worked flawlessly, the culmination of my sweat and silence. And now, this letter. A patent, they say, already exists. Someone, somewhere, thought of it too. I can't help but wonder how many hours I could have saved, how many late nights and skipped meals. But I didn’t just build a machine; I believed in something. It’s hard to see that belief dimming, one paperclip and wire at a time. What now? Do I abandon it, or find a way to make it sing in a different key? The world is vast, surely there’s room for two suns.
